chunks.ar: كان سعيد بن سالم يعيش في زمن الخليفة هارون الرشيد،
chunks.en_old: Said ibn Salim lived in Harun al-Rashid’s time
chunks.en_new: Said ibn Salim lived in the time of Caliph Harun al-Rashid,

chunks.ar: وقد تراكمت عليه ديون كثيرة.
chunks.en_old: and had fallen deep into debt.
chunks.en_new: and had fallen deep into debt.

chunks.ar: صار الدائنون يأتون إلى بابه كل يوم، ويطالبونه بأموالهم،
chunks.en_old: Creditors crowded his door daily,
chunks.en_new: Creditors came to his door every day, demanding their money,

chunks.ar: حتى ضاقت به السبل ولم يعرف من أين يبدأ.
chunks.en_old: leaving him desperate.
chunks.en_new: until he was at a loss and did not know where to begin.

chunks.ar: ذهب إلى رجل يعرفه اسمه عبد الله بن مالك،
chunks.en_old: He sought advice from Abdullah ibn Malik,
chunks.en_new: He went to a man he knew named Abdullah ibn Malik

chunks.ar: وسأله عن طريقة للخروج من محنته.
chunks.en_old: who said only the powerful Barmakid family
chunks.en_new: and asked him for a way out of his trouble.

chunks.ar: قال عبد الله إن أحدًا لا يستطيع أن يساعده مثل أسرة البرامكة،
chunks.en_old: could rescue him
chunks.en_new: Abdullah said no one could help him like the Barmakid family,

chunks.ar: وإن عليه أن يطلب عونها.
chunks.en_old: from his debts.
chunks.en_new: and that he should ask for their help.

chunks.ar: تردد سعيد،
chunks.en_old: Said hesitated,
chunks.en_new: Said hesitated,

chunks.ar: وقال إنه يخشى أن يقابله أبناؤها بكلام متعالٍ ولا يعطوه شيئًا.
chunks.en_old: afraid the brothers would treat him arrogantly.
chunks.en_new: saying he feared its sons would meet him with arrogant words and give him nothing.

chunks.ar: أجابه عبد الله بأن عليه أن يحتمل ما يسمعه،
chunks.en_old: Abdullah advised him to endure any unpleasantness
chunks.en_new: Abdullah answered that he must bear whatever he heard,

chunks.ar: ما دام يريد إنقاذ بيته من الدائنين المتجمعين حوله.
chunks.en_old: if it meant escaping his creditors.
chunks.en_new: as long as he wanted to save his home from the creditors gathered around him.

chunks.ar: زار سعيد الفضل وجعفر، وهما ابنا يحيى بن خالد،
chunks.en_old: Said visited al-Fadl and Jaafar, Yahya’s sons,
chunks.en_new: Said visited al-Fadl and Jaafar, Yahya’s sons,

chunks.ar: وحكى لهما حاله.
chunks.en_old: and explained his plight.
chunks.en_new: and explained his plight.

chunks.ar: سمعا كلامه، ودعوا الله أن يفرج كربه ويرزقه الغنى،
chunks.en_old: They prayed that God would relieve him,
chunks.en_new: They listened, and prayed that God would relieve his distress and make him rich,

chunks.ar: لكنهما لم يسلماه مالًا وهو جالس أمامهما.
chunks.en_old: but handed him no money.
chunks.en_new: but they did not hand him any money while he sat before them.

chunks.ar: خرج سعيد حزينًا، وعاد إلى عبد الله يشكو أن الزيارة لم تنفعه.
chunks.en_old: Disappointed, Said returned to Abdullah and complained.
chunks.en_new: Said left sad and went back to Abdullah, complaining that the visit had not helped him.

chunks.ar: دعاه عبد الله إلى الجلوس بقية اليوم، لعل شيئًا يتغير.
chunks.en_old: Abdullah asked him to stay awhile in case help arrived,
chunks.en_new: Abdullah invited him to sit for the rest of the day, in case something changed.

chunks.ar: جلس الرجل مهمومًا،
chunks.en_old: and Said sat
chunks.en_new: The man sat, troubled,

chunks.ar: وهو يفكر في الديون التي تنتظره في البيت.
chunks.en_old: worrying about his debts.
chunks.en_new: thinking of the debts waiting for him at home.

chunks.ar: لم يمر وقت طويل حتى جاء خادم سعيد مسرعًا،
chunks.en_old: Soon Said’s servant arrived breathlessly:
chunks.en_new: Before long, Said's servant came hurrying

chunks.ar: وقال إن عند باب البيت بغالًا كثيرة محملة بالأموال،
chunks.en_old: loaded mules stood outside their house
chunks.en_new: and said many mules loaded with money stood at the door of the house,

chunks.ar: ورجلًا يحمل رسالة من الفضل وجعفر.
chunks.en_old: with a messenger bearing a letter
chunks.en_new: with a man carrying a letter from al-Fadl and Jaafar.

chunks.ar: أسرع سعيد إلى منزله وفتح الرسالة بيد مرتجفة.
chunks.en_old: from the two brothers.
chunks.en_new: Said hurried home and opened the letter with a trembling hand.

chunks.ar: كتب الأخوان أنهما أخبرا الخليفة بحاله،
chunks.en_old: The letter explained that the caliph
chunks.en_new: The brothers wrote that they had told the caliph about his situation,
chunks.note: omitted that brothers told the caliph

chunks.ar: فأمر له بمليون درهم لسداد الدين،
chunks.en_old: had granted one million dirhams for debts
chunks.en_new: and he ordered one million dirhams for him to pay off the debt,

chunks.ar: ثم أضاف ثلاثمئة ألف لينفق منها بعد السداد.
chunks.en_old: and three hundred thousand for living expenses.
chunks.en_new: then added three hundred thousand for him to spend after paying it.

chunks.ar: وأرسل كل واحد من الأخوين مليونًا آخر من ماله الخاص.
chunks.en_old: Each brother also gave a million personally.
chunks.en_new: Each brother also gave a million personally.

chunks.ar: صار مجموع ما وصل إلى سعيد
chunks.en_old: Said received
chunks.en_new: The total that reached Said came to

chunks.ar: ثلاثة ملايين وثلاثمئة ألف درهم.
chunks.en_old: three million three hundred thousand dirhams altogether.
chunks.en_new: three million three hundred thousand dirhams.

chunks.ar: عندها فهم أن الفضل وجعفر لم يكتفيا بالكلام الطيب،
chunks.en_old: The brothers had worked quietly after his visit
chunks.en_new: Then he understood that al-Fadl and Jaafar had not stopped at kind words,

chunks.ar: بل عملا في الخفاء ليكون العون أكبر مما توقع، وليبدأ حياة جديدة.
chunks.en_old: to secure far more help than he imagined.
chunks.en_new: but had worked in secret so the help would be greater than he expected, and he could start a new life.
